purpose: Prove the V5.1 selection executes correctly through the REAL production training path (data consumption, masking, objective, optimizer, WSD mechanism, clipping, checkpointing, fresh-process exact resume, receipts) and can acquire the clean integration instrument. NOT a cognition experiment; NOT scale authorization.
claim_ceiling: V5.1 executed successfully through the specified development-scale production training path and satisfied the canary's mechanical/integration gates.

B.role: development GPU canary (Colab T4 operator execution)
B.memory_plan: weights+moments+grads ~18B/param = 0.71 GiB plus activations; T4 16GiB headroom verified by preflight calibration before substantive run

dataset.split_rule: latent-world group level; sealed generated FIRST and hashed before training
screens: shortcut baselines per family; any family solved >= 0.35 by a trivial baseline is repaired or removed BEFORE training

tokenizer: frozen 24,576-entry BPE artifact artifacts/e1/local_tournament/tokenizer-24576.json.gz (identity-bound, receipt-verified); special tokens pad=0 unk=1 bos=2 eos=3

training.optimizer: production build_adamw_optimizer: AdamW beta(0.9,0.95) eps 1e-8 wd 0.1 selective groups
training.schedule: canary-scaled WSD through the production backend schedule interface: warmup 10% -> stable to 85% -> linear decay to 0.1x peak (peak 3e-4); shape receipt bound to v5_training.schedule.schedule_receipt; frozen 5B lr_at verified on its real domain (probe points 0/25M/50M-1/50M/4.5B-1/5B-1)
training.objective: canonical causal_lm_loss (BOS/PAD/segment excluded, EOS included); aux lambdas 0; answer+EOS supervision via document termination

evaluation.mode: candidate-free greedy generation with EOS stop; exact-with-valid-EOS
evaluation.sealed_rule: sealed generated first, hashed, untouched until finalize; any inspection invalidates it and forces regeneration with recorded invalidation

mechanical: no prohibited shortcut (all baselines < 0.35 per family)
token accounting exact (window ledger == TrainingState ledger)
WSD trace lr_expected == lr_actual at every update; zero rewarm events; resume continues schedule
checkpoints durable (store-verified); fresh-process resume bitwise-equal state on CPU
no EXPERIMENT_ONLY output mode in the canonical path

formation_diagnostics: train acquisition, dev transfer, sealed result reported SEPARATELY; never collapsed
stop_conditions: requested updates exceed the frozen pack stream
boundaries: R1C and ARK-020 untouched; canonical output path only
no production-corpus claims from synthetic canary data

amendments.reason: the 300-world pack produced ~18 update windows (~75k tokens) but the frozen WSD budget requires 491,520 tokens (120 updates x 4096); the runner failed closed (FAIL_CLOSED: requested updates exceed the frozen pack stream) BEFORE any scientific outcome existed. Single-epoch coverage removes data repetition from the formation probe. No threshold, seed, geometry, or gate changed.

measured pack: 2000 worlds/family yields 315,200 real tokens/epoch (< the frozen 491,520-token budget) because canary prompts average ~31 tokens. Amendment 1's single-epoch principle retained; 3305 worlds/family measured-scale to 521k tokens (> budget with ~6% bucket-rounding margin). Thresholds, seeds, geometry, gates unchanged; no scientific outcome existed at amendment time.
